```json
 "rationale": "26 dB needs one stage, and the 5T OTA's single dominant pole at CL gives PM near 90 deg. Each side needs gm1 >= 2*pi*43M*2p = 540 uS. I target about 800 uS: input gm/Id 13 at 64 uA per side, from a 128 uA tail (12.8x IREF). Slew is 64 V/us. L=0.5 on the pair and loads gives about 32 dB. The PMOS mirror pole (~400 MHz) is far above UGBW. Headroom at VCM=0.9 is 0.2 V for the tail and 0.5 V for the input pair."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (13.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "gmid_ld": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),
    "L_ld":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "Itail":   (128e-6, 80e-6, 300e-6),
    "gmid_t":  (11.0, 7.0, 15.0),
    "L_t":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it = p["Itail"]
    ih = it / 2.0

    # Tail current source and its bias diode (same L and gm/Id; only Id is scaled)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], it, vds=0.25)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)
    vtail = vcm - 0.75  # estimated tail-node voltage

    # Input pair
    vsb = max(vtail, 0.0)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], ih, vds=0.5, vsb=vsb)

    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], ih, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    # Analytic predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cpar = m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * (cl + cpar))

    # Mirror pole: gm3 over the mirror-node capacitance
    cmir = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    # Pole-zero doublet: the zero sits at 2x the pole, so the phase hit is reduced
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fmir)))

    # Settling: slew phase plus about 4.6 linear time constants
    slew = it / (cl + cpar)
    vstep = 0.5
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = max(vstep - ih / gm1 * 2, 0) / slew + 4.6 * tau

    power = vdd * (it + iref)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "settle": settle, "power": power}
```
